title: Perfect pushforward and restriction for supported open immersions
statement: Let j:(U, O_U) \to (X, O_X) be an open immersion of ringed spaces [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], and let T be a closed subset of X contained in U. For a complex, cohomology supported on T means that every cohomology sheaf restricts to zero on X minus T. If F is a perfect object of D(O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T, then Rj_*F is perfect on X [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Moreover, for every E in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T, the canonical map E \to Rj_*(E restricted to U) is an isomorphism, and for every such F the canonical map j_!F \to Rj_*F is an isomorphism.
